### A Day of Ash in the City of Ashes
Author: Robin Ham
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://store.thegospelcoalition.org/assets/product_downloads/4813/RByspfCRcQUJttPjEnsMd3F200a2NKCgpWrWhVS3.pdf
Passage: Lamentations 1:1a
Points:
- The book opens overlooking the tragic ruins of Jerusalem, once vibrant with life but reduced to silence and ash.
- The opening Hebrew exclamation "How?!" voices profound sorrow rather than polite confusion over catastrophic loss.
- Confronting devastation and mortality mirrors the message of Ash Wednesday, reminding believers of the wages of sin.
- Honest lament does not end in despair, because walking through death points forward to resurrection hope in Christ.

### The Lamentations of Jeremiah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lamentations-jeremiah
Passage: Lamentations 1:1-14
Points:
- The devastating destruction of Jerusalem in 586 B.C. was the tragic fulfillment of covenant warnings against persistent rebellion.
- Jeremiah affirmed the righteousness of God's judgment while weeping bitterly over the horrors suffered by his people.
- Believers are taught never to take malicious pleasure in the suffering of others, even when that suffering is deserved.
- True love toward sinners means upholding God's justice while maintaining genuine, godly grief over those who go astray.
